reason: Eight-process GPU evaluation incurred substantial device-call overhead. A full-budget CPU runtime check on a TRAINING instance completed in 1.38 seconds versus about 22 seconds per GPU-concurrent evaluation. This was a runtime-only decision, without selecting on test objectives.
note: CPU and CUDA random streams are different. All four PPO variants are evaluated afresh on CPU with the same per-instance, preference and restart seed. GPU pilot records are retained but excluded. GA is likewise rerun for homogeneous timing conditions.
